analyst_view.overall: Slavia are 34th of 36 with 1 point and Villarreal 29th with 3, so both are below the top-24 line and need a win; Slavia have not won a Champions League game since 2007 but lead the Czech league, while Villarreal lost 3-2 at Barcelona on Saturday after leading 2-0. Slavia are without Sturm, Chaloupek, Pitak, Ouanda and Ogbu, all counted (Sturm alone takes about a quarter off their goals), and one injury list today also has Provod out after surgery, Moses (hamstring) and Kante injured and striker Chory left out by the coach, none of whom the numbers list. Villarreal miss Foyth, Akhomach, Diatta, Saliba and Gerard Moreno, and the same list has defender Mourino suspended after three yellow cards; Spanish previews expected some rotation. Slovenian referee Rade Obrenovic, with a slightly low card record, is already counted.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.4 goals (0.9 Slavia, 2.4 Villarreal), already cutting Slavia hard for Sturm and the other injured players. On top of that, one report today has Provod, Moses and Kante out and Chory not selected, which leaves Slavia's attack very thin, and Villarreal are rotating with Gerard Moreno still out; I lean a bit lower, to about 3.3.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.1 corners, fairly even (4.1 Slavia, 5.1 Villarreal), with Slavia's recent corner run counted. Slavia must attack at home and like crossing, Villarreal play through wide areas, and the absences change little here, so I stay at 9.1.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.5 cards, already taking a little off for Obrenovic's slightly low card record and Slavia's calmer recent run. Both sides need the win and Villarreal lose Mourino to a ban (one report), but nothing points clearly to a rougher or calmer game than the numbers expect, so I stay at 4.5.

shots.text: The numbers say 31.2 shots, lifted for Slavia's heavy recent shooting (+15.9%). With Provod, Moses and Chory reported missing, Slavia lose their main creators and shooters from midfield and up front, which the numbers can't see, so I trim to about 30.3.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.1 on target, with Slavia's recent accuracy counted (+11.3%). A thinner Slavia attack and a rotated Villarreal side point to slightly fewer good chances, so I lean a little lower, to about 9.8.
